g.text: The fixed byte budget imposes an authored-bundle recovery ceiling

Ceiling uses the smallest declared sufficient-original set serialized as whole records. Authored sets are non-exhaustive. A changes both index cues and packet byte cost; conditional feasible-query recovery is separately tabulated without changing the frozen
